verdict.rationale: A business-filing agency could plausibly offer a system-to-system channel such as bulk-filer accounts or a transmitter program, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing rails: paper mail-in, a web online-filing system, and phone or credit-card forms. Nothing documents a programmatic channel, system accounts, a batch-provider program, or a published enrollment path for one. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the filing host reset an automated connection, which shows no machine access but does not rule out an undocumented enrolled channel.
